description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Public records] Recent SEC EDGAR filings of a US-listed company by ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or CIK: company name, CIK, tickers, exchanges, SIC industry, fiscal year end and state of incorporation, then the filings (form, filing and report date, accession number, description, 8-K items, XBRL flag, document and index URLs), filtered by form types and date, with counts per form. Listed companies only (CIKs in the SEC ticker list; no individuals). Documents are linked, not read. No key; cached 10 min. ~0.5-3 s.

company.description: Stock ticker of a US-listed company (AAPL, BRK-B) or its SEC CIK number (320193)

forms.description: Comma list of form types to keep, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K (amendments like 10-K/A are included); default all

max_results.description: Filings returned, 1-100 (default 20); matched is always the full count in the recent list

since.description: Filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

name: sec_filings

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: SEC EDGAR filings of a listed company ($0.002/call)
